buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 2. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SPECIAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS – MEDICAL NITROUS OXIDE (N₂O) These Special Terms and Conditions shall be read in conjunction with the GeM General Terms and Conditio ns (GTC), the Scope of Supply and the Technical Specifications. The contract period shall be six (06) mon ths, effective from the date of the supply order. 1. The firm, while submitting its bid, shall upload copies of a valid licence issued by the State Drug Co ntroller under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940, GST registration, PAN and such other documents specifi

ed in the vendor checklist / eligibility criteria. Bids incomplete in any respect or not accompanied by the re quisite documents are liable to be rejected. 2. The firm shall be a manufacturer / supplier / distributor of medical gases, including Medical Nitrous Oxide. A bid without a valid licence / authorisation for the offered medical gas, wherever applicable, shall n ot be considered for evaluation and is liable to be rejected. 3. The firm shall hold a valid licence for storage, filling and cylinder testing etc. issued by the Chief Controller of Explosives (CCE) / PESO of the jurisdiction concerned. A self-attested copy of the same shall b e uploaded. 4. The firm shall have facilities for testing of trace impurities in the PPM / PPB range for CO, CO ₂, NO / NO₂, phosphine, ammonia and moisture relevant to nitrous oxide. The facilities shall be open to scrutiny b y the hospital authorities. 5. The firm shall submit test reports whenever demanded by the hospital. The bidder shall enclose an analytical report conforming to the Indian Pharmacopoeia / applicable standards for every batch of supplie d Medical Nitrous Oxide. 6. The firm shall ensure compliance with the applicable Gas Cylinders Rules, 2016 and shall obtain, in time, the necessary filling permission from CCE / PESO under the applicable provisions of the said Rules, w herever required, while supplying cylinders for filling of gases. 7. The firm shall have efficient and safe transport to ensure timely supply of medical gases. 8. As per the Gas Cylinders Rules, 2016 and rules made thereafter as amended from time to time, the firm shall furnish an undertaking that it is legally bound to supply the quoted items as per the latest rules l aid down by the governing authority, failing which it shall be liable to action as deemed fit. 9. The firm shall ensure timely refilling and supply of all sizes of cylinders for the qualified medical ga s. For the present procurement, the offered gas is Medical Nitrous Oxide (N₂O), cylinder capacity approxim ately 955 Litre. 10. The firm shall be legally responsible for any mishap arising on account of non-conformity with the s afety standards and rules. 11. The firm shall not demand security, caution money, holding, demurrage or transportation charges, i nitial installation or uprooting charges, or any other charge not mentioned in the price bid. 12. The firm is bound to supply Medical Nitrous Oxide at the approved rates during the contract period. If the price / applicable GST is reduced for any reason during the contract period, the firm shall intimate th e hospital and reduce the rate immediately. 13. The firm shall be responsible for routine check-up and maintenance of cylinders and vessels at no extra cost. This includes repair of parts/nozzles/accessories of cylinders as and when required. 14. Revision of Rates There shall be no revision of rates during the contract period. 15. The supplier shall have adequate arrangements for supply of medical gases. 16. The bidder shall be responsible for testing and maintenance of cylinders sent for refilling. 17. Infrastructure The firm shall have separate tanks and filling decks for medical and industrial gases to avoid any chance o f mix-up which may be harmful to patients. The firm shall maintain separately identified cylinders for medi cal and industrial gases. 18. Refilling Empty cylinders shall be collected by the supplier from Military Hospital Ahilyanagar for refilling. Refilled c ylinders shall be weighed at the time of delivery / inspection; arrangements for weighing shall be made by the firm. 19. A refilled cylinder received at the time of delivery, if not found in accordance with the Gas Cylinders Rules, 2016 and amendments made from time to time, shall be rejected. Any rejected supply sh

all be taken back and replaced by the firm at its own cost within the specified period, without causing any interruption to hospital services. 20. Delivery of Supplies Routine delivery shall be made on the next working day after collection of indents, and in any case within t wo (02) working days, at the premises of the hospital or as directed. Emergency supplies shall be effected within twelve (12) hours of an emergency call / supply order. If the successful tenderer fails to execute the supply order within the stipulated period, Military Hospital Ahilyanagar shall be at liberty to procure the sa me from an alternative source, and any extra cost so incurred shall be recovered from the firm’s subseque nt bills / performance security. 21. Risk Purchase In case of failure or refusal by the successful tenderer to supply the medical gas, the contract is liable to b e cancelled at the firm’s risk and cost. Any extra cost involved in arranging supplies from an alternative so urce / agency shall be recovered from the firm’s subsequent / pending / forthcoming bills or from the perfo rmance security, as the case may be. Irregular supplies / failure to fulfil the terms of the contract may enta il cancellation of the contract and forfeiture of the performance security. 22. Penalty for Delayed Supply (Liquidated Damages) The firm shall supply the ordered medical gas preferably within one (01) working day and not later than tw o (02) working days. In case of delay beyond the stipulated period, liquidated damages shall be levied in a ccordance with the GeM GTC / DPM-2025 provisions. The exact rate and ceiling shall be as per the ATC loa ded on GeM and shall be stated identically therein. 23. Performance Security The successful bidder shall furnish performance security in the form of an ePBG / as accepted on GeM for 3 % of the contract value, valid for the contract period. Failure to furnish performance security within t he stipulated period shall render the award liable to cancellation and forfeiture of any bid security. 24. Bid Security In lieu of Earnest Money Deposit, bidders shall submit a Bid Security Declaration as per GFR 2017 Rule 170 and the GeM provisions, undertaking that the bidder shall be suspended / debarred for the specified p eriod if it withdraws or modifies its bid during the period of validity, or fails to furnish performance security or execute the contract. 25. Presentation of Bill (a) The contractor shall present the bill for the monthly supply within ten (10) days of the close of each respective month; payment shall be made after due verification. (b) Bills shall be in triplicate, on printed and serially numbered invoice / credit bills bearing the name, address and GST registration number of the firm. (c) The bill shall show the summary of the total amount for the gas and the net amount claimed, suppo rted by the acknowledged first copy of the indent with all columns duly filled in. (d) There shall be a separate invoice for each purchase order. 26. Mode of Payment (a) Military Hospital Ahilyanagar shall follow the e-Payment mode of payment only, through the GeM p ortal. (b) Bills shall be complete in all respects and without errors to prevent rejection / cancellation / delay i n processing. (c) Bills shall be submitted in triplicate, pre-receipted with revenue stamp wherever necessary; all cutt ings / overwriting shall be duly attested. The contractor / supplier shall claim payments as per the procedure prescribed on the GeM portal. No clai m shall lie against Military Hospital Ahilyanagar in respect of interest or damages in case payment is delay

ed for any reason beyond its control. 27. Force Majeure The Force Majeure clause shall apply to both parties in accordance with the GeM GTC. 28. Termination of Contract The purchaser reserves the right to terminate the contract in case of breach of contract in any manner, aft er giving one (01) month’s notice. 29. Ceiling on Ordered Quantity There shall be no binding on the purchaser as to the total cost of supply or the number of cylinders refilled at a time or throughout the contract period; quantities shall be drawn as per actual requirement. . 5. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 6. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED.
